rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: itnet_k=3, unet_c=16, itnet_alpha_init=0.0037, residual_learning=False, pretrain_lr=0.0001, pretrain_epochs=144, pretrain_patience=144, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, train_n=200, val_n=214, grad_clip=1.0, max_train_s=900, seed=42, rationale=ITER-6 (search-20260619-01, corrected 214-slice/321px-FOV metric). CEILING-DOCUMENTATION iter. ONE KNOB vs iter-5: train_n 400->200 (the iter-5 falsifier-prescribed revert), with pretrain_epochs traded 120->144 + pretrain_patience tracked 120->144 (early-stop stays disabled) to RESTORE budget headroom after iter-4 (1237s) and iter-5 (1411s) BOTH overran the 1200s budget; this lands exactly on the iter-3 tn200/ep144 point (actual 744.1s) so it doubles as a tn200 reproducibility/ceiling confirmation. max_train_s 1100->900 (15-min HARD backstop) -- deliberately conservative to GUARANTEE the 214-slice per-sample val + figure finish inside the 30-min wall, ending the two-iter overrun streak. SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, hr=metric of record): (1) PRIOR NUMBERS / TRAJECTORY: iter-1 SSIM 0.4554/hr 0.0 @ep12/tn200 in 170.2s; iter-2 0.5888/hr 0.0 @ep48 in 345.2s; iter-3 0.6230/hr 0.0 @ep144 in 744.1s; iter-4 0.7039/hr 0.0 @ep240/tn200 in 1236.9s (OVER budget); iter-5 0.7294/hr 0.0 @ep120/tn400 in 1410.6s (OVER budget; val_psnr 26.87, val_rmse 2.267e-3). Best hr=0.0 throughout; LD-FBP floor SSIM ~0.81 sits ABOVE every iter (max SSIM 0.7294 < 0.81), so hr is pinned at 0 by construction. iter-5 result: train_n 200->400 at EQUAL grad-steps (48000) lifted SSIM +0.0255 (0.7039->0.7294) -- the denoiser DID improve with coverage (mirroring uswin/itnet_v3) BUT hr stayed 0.0: the data-coverage lever lifts the denoiser SSIM, NOT hr. (2) LIMITER (CONFIRMED, structural, NUMERIC): the DC stage in solver_itnet_v2.py carries NO trainable params -- pretrain_denoiser optimizes ONLY denoiser.parameters() on (fbp,truth) residual pairs, then ItNetV2 runs itnet.eval() with the k=3 DC operator FIXED (log_alpha never optimized). BINDING KNOB: BOTH in-budget learnable levers are now MAPPED and BOTH saturate below the 0.81 FBP floor -- pretrain_epochs (iter-1->4: 0.4554->0.7039 with sharply diminishing +0.133/+0.034/+0.081 increments, then budget-pinned at 1237s) and data-coverage train_n (iter-5: +0.0255, hr still 0). Neither learnable lever can clear the floor because the un-trained DC coupling caps the family far below end-to-end itnet_v3 (0.91); the DC log_alpha is the only weight that could fix it and it is structurally frozen (solver edits forbidden). (3) ONE UNTRIED KNOB vs CONFIRM CEILING: the two learnable levers are exhausted; itnet_alpha_init/itnet_k shift a FIXED (non-trainable) operator -> near-zero diagnostic value, and pretrain_lr-up is sibling-unstable above 1e-4. So iter-6 CONFIRMS the ceiling by executing the iter-5 falsifier (revert tn400->200) at the budget-safe ep144 point, documenting v2 as a pretrain-then-FIXED-DC structural cap (hr 0; prefer end-to-end v3) toward the iter-20 ceiling record. (4) HYPOTHESIS + NUMERIC FALSIFIER: reverting train_n 400->200 at ep144 reproduces iter-3 (val_ssim ~0.62, hr 0.000) -- confirming the data-coverage SSIM lift was real (0.7294>0.6230) but irrelevant to hr, and that the untrained-DC structural cap, not data/epochs, is the binding limiter. FALSIFIER: if hr CLEARS 0 (val_ssim jumps past the 0.81 LD-FBP floor) at tn200/ep144 -- which it cannot, since iter-3 already ran this exact point at SSIM 0.6230/hr 0 -- the structural-cap verdict is wrong; ANY hr>0 reopens the search. Expectation: SSIM ~0.62, hr 0.000. (5) BUDGET: HARD 20-min (1200s) train+score. tn200 per-epoch = 4.155s/epoch (iter-2->3 slope), fixed 214-slice per-sample val+figure = 145.8s; ep144 -> 144*4.155 + 145.8 = 744s (iter-3 ACTUAL was 744.1s), comfortably UNDER 1200s and well within the 30-min sbatch wall -- ending the iter-4/iter-5 overrun streak. max_train_s=900 (15-min HARD backstop) leaves ample room for the 214-slice per-sample val + figure. val_n=214 KEPT (NOT reduced -- ALL L277 slices), grad_clip=1.0 KEPT. (6) Loop continues -- no control returned. HARD-WIRED (unchanged): staged_canonical data, v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (each slice swaps itnet.projector to its own ps; batch_size=1 + val_chunk=1 FORCED), bg_target=truth, val=ALL 214 L277 slices under the 321px detector-geometry FOV (evaluate_calibrated default for AGENT4CT_DATASET=mayo_ldct_2d; NO fov= override). residual_learning=False KEPT (the CONFIG default True double-applies the residual and collapses eval to ~0.34).
